options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Most popular military aircraft (unique pilots, last 7 days)
panels.description: v1 card 65. Distinct pilots per aircraft type flagged is_military in the aircraft_type lookup. Changed from v1: a lookup flag replaces a 400-entry IN list with wildcard patterns.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT aircraft_icao AS aircraft, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.is_military
GROUP BY aircraft_icao
ORDER BY pilots DESC, aircraft

panels.title: Most popular RAAFv routes (last month)
panels.description: v1 card 78 ('What were the most popular RAAFv routes last month?', edited 07-10-2025). RAAFv flights are those whose flight-plan remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG (case-insensitive), not an aircraft-type list. Window is the last month (UTC), not 7 days. Each session is counted once (v1 de-duplicated on callsign and logon time). Shows share of RAAFv flights and pilots; top 25 routes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.route_label AS route,
       count(*) AS total_flights,
       count(DISTINCT r.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv flights",
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT r.cid) / sum(count(DISTINCT r.cid)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv pilots"
FROM (
  SELECT f.cid, f.route_label,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
    AND f.departure <> '' AND f.arrival <> ''
) r
WHERE r.rn = 1
GROUP BY r.route_label
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, unique_pilots DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Hours flown by RAAFv aircraft per week (last 14 weeks)
panels.description: v1 card 66 ('Hours flown by RAAFv aircraft per week', edited 18-10-2025). RAAFv flights are those whose flight-plan remarks contain RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG (case-insensitive), not an aircraft-type list. Airborne hours per UTC week (v1 summed time online); last 98 days. Weeks start on Monday (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       round((sum(f.airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAAFv hours"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
